project.name: Radernie
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 1 of 8. Strict settlement merit, See, café-led Eat, all named trail providers, picnic, public visitor parking, public toilets, access, transport, dogs and complete local HES/NRHE construction dates were checked before continuing. Peat Inn, Lathones and St Andrews services are not transferred. The through-route alone does not make Radernie a destination town.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Radernie is a dispersed rural hamlet and waypoint on St Margaret’s Way. The through-route is useful context, but there is no independent attraction, café-led stop or public visitor facility to support town-map publication.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: No destination-scale dog visit or dedicated dog facilities are assumed without current evidence.
